run_spm_train: run the sentencepiece trainer script with command-line arguments to train a language model
train_sentencepiece_model: train a SentencePiece vocabulary model by passing input corpus and model path arguments
run_spm_with_quoted_args: run the SentencePiece trainer that safely quotes all command-line arguments before training
create_sentencepiece_vocab: create a SentencePiece vocabulary model from a text corpus using the training script
run_spm_cli_wrapper: run the CLI wrapper that forwards arguments to SentencePieceTrainer for model training
